input_caveat: Inlet concentrations NOT independently measured; test-cycle leakage in binary inlet estimate
A_definition: Fit using all cycles and evaluate those same cycles
B_definition: Fit on early cycles only; compare with held-out late cycle, not fully independent due inlets
direct_IAST: No mixed parameter correction; single parameters reused
calibrated_IAST: Three empirical adjustment factors fit only on mixed training cycles
grid_note: N is selected with parameters held fixed; final predictions at chosen N; parameters fitted at N_fit
species_units: C/Cin, ppmv; qmax mol/kg; b Pa^-1; k min^-1
